description:
Group 17 from the duplicate-check report identifies 3 copies of nearly
identical logic in benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_operations.py:
- _insert_store_returns (line 470, ~44 lines)
- _insert_catalog_returns (line 515, ~44 lines)
- _insert_web_returns (line 564, ~44 lines)

All three follow the same algorithm:
1. Log the insert count
2. Get parameter placeholder
3. Build SELECT ... FROM {sales_table} ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT {n}
4. Execute query, fetch records
5. Handle empty result / error cases identically
6. Loop over records calling self._generate_{type}_returns_from_sale(sale)
7. Call self._execute_batched_insert(connection, table, columns, rows, N)

Only the table/column names and the row generator callback differ.

preserves.behavior: Batched insert behavior identical (same batch size, same error handling)
